entry-actions

components · 0.4.1 · entry-actions · aj-c-entry-actions

The entry action gutter at the right of each entry bar (approved revision): edit and delete as icon buttons and, only on an entry kept out of memory, the quiet memory dropdown (Out of memory and a chevron) whose menu holds the Use in memory checkbox. Memory is one way (decision 2026-10-28): an entry in memory says nothing, and letting one in can't be undone (it asks once). Its parts sit in the entry row's grid (the root is display:contents). Opacity alone reveals the tools on pointer devices; the dropdown is always shown; the text never moves. While an entry is being edited, its deletion confirmed or its use in memory confirmed, the gutter is replaced by the editor or the confirmation, its other two forms.

token--aj-c-entry-actions-shownexposed: The tools' opacity (0 hidden, 1 shown) where hover reveals them; the row sets it. The memory dropdown is not faded.
token--aj-c-entry-actions-eventsexposed: none while hidden, auto when shown; the row sets it with --aj-c-entry-actions-shown.
token--aj-c-entry-actions-fadeexposed: The reveal fade (120ms out by default; the row sets 160ms in, 0ms with focus inside).
token--aj-c-entry-actions-tools-rowexposed: The grid row the tools take in the row (1; the row sets 2 below 1000, under the text).
token--aj-c-entry-actions-tools-gapexposed: The space above the tools when they drop under the text (0; the row sets --s2).
token--aj-c-entry-actions-trigger-maxexposed: The open memory trigger's max width (none; the row limits it beside the tools below 1000).
